name: Apartment Gerlos 183
beschreibung:
=== description ===

The Apartment Gerlos 183 is located quietly in the Gerlos neighborhood, close to the mountain lifts. The apartment is well-equipped and offers views of the surrounding mountain landscape. Guests will find a complete living unit with a kitchen and bathroom, ideal for self-catering. The area invites for hiking in summer and skiing in winter. Local shopping and dining options are within walking distance.
